text: Program Description Program Introduction Offer a wide range of courses such as listening, speaking, reading, news reading, comprehensive Chinese, business Chinese, video Chinese and Chinese culture. Enhance students' Chinese language proficiency in an all around way. Students can take live online classes, and teachers provide targeted one-on-one tutoring to students after classes via the teaching app. The mode is small class size teaching, and a class can be set up as long as there are three students or a bit more. The learning time can be arranged flexibly according to students' specific conditions, and the class lasts 8 weeks. This way, every student can have the chance to start learning the language as soon as possible, making it the best choice for those who want to learn Chinese but cannot come to China. School Time Duration(off line): Mar 6, 2023～ Jun 23, 2023 Class time: 9:00am～12:10pm (From Monday to Friday) 20 class hours per week Class Level Class level: Beginning-Advanced 5 level in total Target Student Learn Chinese in an all-around way Option Course(s) In order to help students improve their Chinese level and further their understanding of Chinese culture, we offer a wide range of optional courses in accordance with students' Chinese language proficiency. Students Life we organize a variety of cultural activities every semester. You can learn how to play Tai Chi, cook Chinese food, visit the Great Wall in the spring, enjoy the scene of leaves falling in the fall, go to acrobatics shows, exhibitions, and eat delicious food. We also have Chinese culture festivals, calligraphy contests, and photography contests organized by students.
